name: Mine beetle
description: a dog-sized beetle of the Ember Wastes, glossy dark brown carapace banded with dull orange, six stout legs, long antennae, carrying glowing smouldering eggs

poses.stand: a dog-sized beetle crawling right on six stout legs, a dark brown glossy carapace banded with dull orange, two small glowing orange eggs tucked under its tail, antennae raised
poses.struck: just hit and flipping onto its back, legs splayed, carapace cracked and glowing orange
poses.dead: on its back, legs curled, the carapace split with embers fading

idle.action: crawls in place, legs scuttling, antennae twitching

attack.action: pushes out a glowing orange egg from under its tail onto the ground behind it, then crawls on

hurt.action: is struck, flinches, antennae snapping back, then recovers

die.action: flips over, the carapace cracks open with orange light and it bursts into embers and soot
